{{Quote|Zey to all Special Ops personnel, Inner Rim. Code Five, Code Five. Repeat, Code Five, Code Five. Any way you can, people. Keep comlink overrides open. May the Force be with you.|Arligan Zey|<ref name="Order 66" />}}
'''Code Five''' was a contingency code used by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Once activated, Code Five recalled the entire Special Operations Brigade to the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], if it was in danger and needed protection. [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Arligan Zey]] broadcasted the order at the start of the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].

==Description==
Employed by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]], a [[Brigade/Legends|brigade]] of [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], Code Five was one of a long list of worst-case scenario contingency codes used by the unit. Once activated, the order called for the immediate recall of all Special Operations personnel to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], in the event that it was under threat and needed to be defended. The Special Operations Brigade's [[Director of Special Forces]] could activate the order.<ref name="Order 66" />

==History==
{{Quote|What’s happening? Have they Code-Fived us yet?''"<br />"''Inner Rim only. Anyway, aren’t we busy enough?|Scorch, to Sev|<ref name="Order 66" />}}
[[File:Coruscant-EotE.jpg|thumb|250px|right|If the planet Coruscant (pictured) was under attack, Code Five could be broadcast to recall all Special Operations personnel to the planet.]]
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Galactic Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Arligan Zey]], the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the Special Operations Brigade, broadcasted Code Five through a signal to all Special Operations personnel in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], following the Confederacy's [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|invasion of Coruscant]]. Although every [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] in the brigade and their accompanying [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] heard the order, including the members of [[Omega Squad]] who immediately deployed to Coruscant, Arligan Zey's order was limited to personnel stationed or located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Order 66" />

Three [[Standard day/Legends|days]] later, [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad's]] demolitions expert, [[Scorch/Legends|Scorch]], asked his [[Squad/Legends|squad]] if they had been called back to Coruscant by Code Five, to which [[Sev/Legends|Sev]], the squad's [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]], responded that the recall order was limited to the Inner Rim and that they were already occupied with their [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Clone Wars)|covert mission]] on the<ref name="Order 66" /> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="Kashyyyk">{{DB|location|kashyyyk|Kashyyyk}}</ref> planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="Order 66" />

==Behind the scenes==
Code Five was mentioned in the [[2008]] novel ''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]'', the fourth novel in the [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]], written by author [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="Order 66" />
